pages: Tama, a boy of nine, hair shorn short with one piece left long at the front, purple hoodie, stands in his bedroom pulling one sleeve higher past his elbow. Middle distance: a school satchel on the floor, a coat on the hook. Background: a small window with winter on it. Cold blue daylight.

Tama, a boy of nine, hair shorn short with one piece left long at the front, purple hoodie, comes off his scooter and braces his left palm flat on one grey concrete kerb. Middle distance: the scooter on its side, a dropped helmet. Background: the top of a street, parked cars, houses. Bright morning light.

Tama, a boy of nine, hair shorn short with one piece left long at the front, purple hoodie, rests his left forearm on a clinic bench inside one white plaster cast from under his knuckles to below the elbow. Middle distance: a black marker pen, a paper cup. Background: a corridor window, a long bench. Flat morning light.

Tama, a boy of nine, hair shorn short with one piece left long at the front, purple hoodie, holds up one clear plastic bag from the fruit shop taped over his left hand at the bathroom sink. Middle distance: a roll of tape on the sill, a folded towel. Background: a frosted window. Grey winter light.

Tama, a boy of nine, hair shorn short with one piece left long at the front, purple hoodie, lies on his back with one white plaster cast held straight up in the air, the blanket kicked to the floor. Middle distance: a bedside lamp, a glass of water. Background: a dark bedroom. Lamplight only.

Tama, a boy of nine, hair shorn short with one piece left long at the front, purple hoodie, pushes the handle end of one plastic spoon under the plaster at his wrist, teeth clenched. Middle distance: one pair of pliers on the bedsheet, a butter knife. Background: his bedroom wall. Lamplight.

Tama, a boy of nine, hair shorn short with one piece left long at the front, purple hoodie, holds his left hand up and watches one thumbnail go white and slowly come back to pink. Middle distance: the white cast, a wooden chair back. Background: a clinic room, a high window. Bright daylight.

Tama, a boy of nine, hair shorn short with one piece left long at the front, purple hoodie, holds his left forearm out flat with one round-bladed cast saw resting and buzzing along the white plaster. Middle distance: a folded towel, a clinic bench. Background: a corridor window. Sharp morning light.

Tama, a boy of nine, hair shorn short with one piece left long at the front, purple hoodie, pushes two fingers under the loose rim of one white plaster cast at his wrist. Middle distance: the cast saw on the bench, a tape measure. Background: a clinic room wall, a window. Flat daylight.

Tama, a boy of nine, hair shorn short with one piece left long at the front, purple hoodie, holds one wet plaster cast under the cold tap in both hands, water running white over it. Middle distance: a folded towel, a rubber band. Background: a bathroom window, white tiles. Grey winter light.

Tama, a boy of nine, hair shorn short with one piece left long at the front, purple hoodie, sits on the clinic bench and holds out his left forearm with one tape measure lying round it, the mended arm slimmer than the other. Middle distance: the cast on the bench, a black marker. Background: a window, a radiator. Bright daylight.

Tama, a boy of nine, hair shorn short with one piece left long at the front, purple hoodie, holds one x-ray film flat against a window pane and turns it sideways. Middle distance: a cast-iron radiator, a wooden chair. Background: the window and the wall beyond it. Sharp clear morning light.

Tama, a boy of nine, hair shorn short with one piece left long at the front, purple hoodie, sits on his bed writing in a notebook with one pencil, a plaster cast on the shelf above him. Middle distance: an alarm clock, a school satchel. Background: his bedroom wall. Evening lamplight.

Tama, a boy of nine, hair shorn short with one piece left long at the front, purple hoodie, rubs the notebook out with his sleeve and writes again with one soft pencil. Middle distance: the plaster cast on the shelf above him, a blue alarm clock. Background: his bedroom at night. Lamplight.
